The open floor concept provides ample space to gather, prepare meals, and relax. Wake up in the morning and enjoy the beautiful screened in porch, and wind down at night by the fire pit. No need to pack beach gear- there are beach chairs, umbrellas, a wagon, and coolers! Relax by the community pool just steps away. Close to 30A Avenue for upscale shopping and wonderful dining options! Only 0.7 mi to the public beach. SPACE Vitamin Sea has a spacious open floor plan with a gourmet kitchen. The dining table seats up to six and the expansive island has seating for four. Enjoy the screened in porch with outdoor patio furniture, the backyard with a gas fire pit and gas grill, or relax on the welcoming front porch with rockers. The Master bedroom is tucked away on the first floor with a luxurious en-suite bathroom, double sinks and walk in shower. Upstairs there are three guest rooms, two share a Jack n Jill bathroom and there is a 3rd full bathroom off of the hall. A bonus room in the loft completes the upstairs area with a TV, sofa, and armchair. For your convenience, a full size washer and dryer is located on the first floor and beach towels, a beach wagon, beach chairs, and umbrellas are provided for your stay. Three Roku TV's have "Guest Mode" activated to conveniently sign into your preferred online streaming channels. ACCOMMODATIONS Vitamin Sea comfortably accommodates up to 9 people: -Master Bedroom: 1 King Bed - Ensuite with double sink and walk in shower -Bedroom 2: 1 King Bed - Jack n Jill Bathroom with shower/tub combo -Bedroom 3: 1 King Bed- Jack n Jill Bathroom with shower/tub combo -Bedroom 4: 1 Twin over Queen Bunk - hall bathroom with walk in shower **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING There are two parking spaces in the driveway. Additional parking spaces are available by the community pool. LOCTION Home is located in Inlet Beach, within The Preserve at Inlet Beach - A coastal community just 0.7 miles away from Inlet Beach access points and less than five minutes to the heart of Rosemary Beach. It's located directly behind the new, upscale shopping and dining center - 30Avenue, and close proximity to Rosemary Beach. The home is also just a short drive to Publix grocery store. This neighborhood is a mix of full/part-time residents and vacation rentals. It's very quiet and friendly! The community features a superb outdoor pool with a pavilion, seating, and and outdoor fireplace. The community boardwalk & dock provides direct access to Powell Lake should you wish to rent paddle boards or kayaks during your stay. 0.4 mile (2 min drive)~ 30 Avenue Shops and Restaurants, weekly live music events, the Donut Hole 0.8 mile ~Inlet Beach Access at S. Wall St. 1 mile~Inlet Public Beach Access at S Orange St. with parking, ramp, showers and restrooms 1 mile~Rosemary Beach/Barrett Square/Farmers Market 2 miles~Camp Helen State Park offering pristine beaches, trails that wind through dunes and along Lake Powell, one of the largest rare coastal dune lakes found only a few places in the world. 1.8 miles (5 min drive) - Publix Grocery Store Panama City Beach 20 miles (25-30 mins) Panama City Beach Airport (ECP) Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. NEARBY BEACH ACCESS Inlet Beach has several beach access options to choose from. Below are the 3 most popular: -Winston Lane Public Beach Access: Located less than .08 away. This access is on the western border of Inlet Beach where it meets Rosemary. There is not public parking available, but plenty of bike racks if you choose to ride a bike. -Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access: This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. Located 0.8 miles from house. -Wall Street Beach Access: Located about a mile drive from the Preserve at Inlet Beach, about 200 yards east of the intersection of US30A and Highway 98, at the end of South Wall Street, where it dead ends at the gulf. NOTE: This Access has no public parking. There is no parking but there is parking, along with restrooms and outdoor showers about 1/4 mile east at the Inlet Beach Access. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events.  *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. Sleeps 12-Pool, Spa, Fire Pit Description Welcome to 'Gulf Bridge,'  a luxury, modern coastal home with stunning Gulf views! This exquisite Gulf view home is located in 30A's premiere gated neighborhood destination, WaterSound Peninsula. Details from the generous patio/deck space, heated pool & spa, gas fire pit, to the rooftop retreat are beyond compare! Every element has been fine-tuned to perfection, making it a home for all to enjoy. Gulf Bridge is truly a home to experience a luxury vacation! Simply relax and watch the sunset over the Gulf of Mexico, take a dip in the private pool, or stroll along the meandering boardwalks that lead you to the white sand beaches of the beautiful Emerald Coast. This home has five bedrooms, five and a half bathrooms, living space area, and a generous sized kitchen. Offering impeccable accommodations for up to twelve, guests will love this community. This home offers seclusion compared to most areas of 30A so close to the water and one of the quietest stretches of beach along 30A. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Gulf and white sandy beaches a short boardwalk away -Access to private beach with optional chair service (additional charge direct to vendor) -Located on Camp Creek Lake -Parking Spaces: 4 in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table for 6, Island Seating for 4, Outdoor Dining Table -Panoramic Gulf Views From Viewing Tower -Fourth Floor Viewing Tower -Private Heated Pool With Spa **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $80/day. No street parking allowed. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 8 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WATERSOUND COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate, which can be accessed directly from the boardwalk in front of the home) -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Bike to Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) **Please Note: *Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. *WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals. ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 12 5 Bedrooms / 5.5 Baths FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath -Laundry SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 2 (Primary): King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 4: 2 Twin Bunk Beds (4 Beds Total) with Private Bath -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath -Half Bath HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. Description Welcome to 'Casamigos,'  the beach getaway home you have been searching for! Stylish centrally located home on a quiet street in the heart of Seagrove. Just a short stroll to beach accesses, and a quick bike ride to Seaside, Watercolor, the Big Chill (formerly The Hub ). This four story home features 4 Bedrooms, several screened-in porches, a rooftop deck and a game room! Enjoy the beautiful open concept kitchen, dining, and living room. The kitchen and main living area is located on the 2nd floor. When you are ready to wind down, each of the 4 bedrooms comes with its own en-suite bathroom, so everyone in your group can have some privacy. We include 6 bikes and a golf cart to enjoy scenic 30A! **Pet Friendly (2 Dogs- $250/dog) ACCOMMODATIONS: Casamigos comfortably accommodates up to 10 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, ensuite (1st floor) Bedroom 2: 1 King, ensuite (2nd floor) Bedroom 3: 1 King, ensuite (3rd floor) Bedroom 4: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk, ensuite (3rd floor) BEACH ACCESS Three access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. Eastern Lake Beach Access is on the west side of Eastern Lake where the outfall meets the beach at the intersection of South Gulf Drive and Eastern Lake Road, about 1/4 mile south of Scenic 30A. The access has a shower, a bike rack, and a few parking spaces on Eastern Lake Drive. Eastern Lake is one of our rare coastal dune lakes in SoWal, which periodically open to exchange waters with the gulf. 2. Ramsgate beach access is a simple walkover near the end of Eastern Lake Road behind Summer s Edge neighborhood beside Ramsgate townhomes. This access does not have parking or showers. 3. Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.3 miles East of the home) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: 6-Seater Golf Cart 6 Bikes Community Pool (Unheated) Coffee Maker Grill Propane 4th Floor lounge and deck Wrap around screened-in balcony Game Room Screened in porch Smart TVs Fully stocked kitchen **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING This home includes 4 parking space on the gravel driveway with NO overflow parking available. No RV or trailer parking in the driveway. NEIGHBORHOOD Many walkable neighborhood amenities including: -Community pool (unheated) -2 Beach Accesses -30-A Bicycle Trail -Greenway Station featuring shopping, coffee, ice cream, and dining ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. The property is located within a short walk to a private community pool and two access points to the beautiful Emerald Coast beaches - one directly to the beach, and one to Eastern Lake, a coastal dune lake that flows right into the gulf- a phenomena that is found in one of 4 places in the World. You ll find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party s needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *Up to 2 dogs allowed. Pet fee of $250/dog applies. Host must be notified of pet prior to arrival. 2 Pets Max! *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools, and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Description Welcome to 'Barefoot Bliss,'  where elegant design meets exquisite Gulf-front location! Located in a highly sought-after Dune Allen Beach community, Barefoot Bliss is a 6-bedroom, 7-bathroom luxury home that sleeps 14 comfortably. With stunning emerald water views from the private pool and direct access to the beach, this home perfectly embodies 30A living! The ground level of this home offers on-site parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway, as well as the convenience of a bathroom and laundry room. Additionally, the laundry room has one set of twin over twin bunk beds. Upon entering this 4-story residence, guests will find a bright great room, aglow with sunshine from the stunning Gulf-front views. An inviting living area offers plush seating around a 75” TV, while a nearby sitting room provides additional comforts with a queen sleeper sofa—ideal for last-minute visitors. Guests can easily prepare cocktails with a wine fridge and ice maker at the wet bar before sitting at the 10-seat dining table for a home-cooked meal. The pristine white kitchen, featuring a stunning marble island with a built-in sink, is fully equipped with high-end Thermador appliances, making it easy to host large groups. Enjoy access to the spacious outdoor deck from anywhere in the great room—swim in the private pool with a built-in sitting spa, relax on 4 cozy loungers, or grill up some snacks in the outdoor kitchen. Guests can use the stairs or in-home elevator to access the top floors of this home. The third floor offers 3 stylish guest bedrooms with great views, each boasting access to a rear balcony overlooking the pool. Just down the hallway is a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as a stacked washer and dryer for convenience. The fourth floor offers similar accommodations—a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as another closet with a stacked washer and dryer. There are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms with access to a rear balcony overlooking beautiful Gulf waters. Both the third and fourth floor wet bars are stocked with a Keurig machine for the early risers! This beachfront property provides incredible amenities and spectacular views, as well as being a prime location for exploring local shops and restaurants. With 8 adult bikes—plus a 6-passenger golf cart—getting around has never been easier. Experience the ultimate relaxation and convenience at Barefoot Bliss!  HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Steps from the beach -Gulf front with spectacular views  -Private pool with Sitting Spa **Pool heating available for $50 per day** -Complimentary beach setups each morning include 8 beach chairs with 4 umbrellas (Mar 1 2025-Feb 28 2026) -6 Passenger golf cart -8 adult bikes -Elevator -Travel Crib and highchair provided -One step from the sand from back door PARKING: Four driveway parking spaces available. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you re ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas. BEACH ACCESS Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Description Welcome to '30A Hideaway,' a stylish & centrally located 3 bed/3 bath townhome in Prominence, perfect for families. New furniture & fixtures! Directly across the street from The Big Chill with restaurants, shops, & events! We include a complimentary 6-seater golf cart & bikes to enjoy scenic 30a! Gourmet kitchen & Smart TV's in every room. Beach access is only a short drive/ bike ride away. No need to pack beach gear- we have you covered! If you prefer the pool, relax by the 5,000 sq. ft. community pool! TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: 30A Hideaway comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bedroom 3: (1) Bunk Bed (twin over twin), (1) Trundle Bed (twin over twin) **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including porch *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Southern Comfort comfortably accommodates up to 10 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 King Bedroom 3: Bunk Bed (Full over Queen) Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa **WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES:** Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools, and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Elegance on Eastern Lake' professionally managed by Stay on 30a, where luxury meets comfort in the laidback Seagrove Beach community of Scenic 30A. Elegance on Eastern Lake is a perfect blend of coastal charm and modern comfort. With over 3,800 square feet of living space, this newly constructed 2-story, 4-bedroom home sleeps 11 comfortably. Nestled under soaring pines overlooking the serene Tresca Lake, it is steps away from the white sandy beaches and emerald green water of 30A, where lifelong memories are made. Description Welcome to 'Relax Away on 30A,'  this stylish & centrally located 3 bed/3 bath townhome in Prominence is perfect for families. New furniture & fixtures! Right across the street from The Big Chill with restaurants, shops, & events! We include a complimentary 6-seater golf cart & 6 bikes to enjoy scenic 30a! Gourmet kitchen & Smart TV's in every room. Beach access is a short drive/bike ride away. No need to pack beach gear- we have you covered! If you prefer the pool, relax by the 5,000 sq. ft. community pool! TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Relax Away on 30A comfortably accommodates up to 9 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 King Bedroom 3: (1) Bunk Bed (queen over queen), (1) Twin Trundle Bed **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. Description Welcome to 'Swept Away' ! This Prominence South 3 bed/3 bath townhome is perfect for families and right next to The Big Chill! New furniture & fixtures! Walk to restaurants, shops, & events! We include a complimentary 6-seater golf cart & bikes to enjoy scenic 30a! Gourmet kitchen & Smart TV's in every room. Beach access is only a short drive/ bike ride away. No need to pack beach gear- we have you covered! If you prefer the pool, relax by the 5,000 sq. ft. community pool! TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Swept Away comfortably accommodates up to 10 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bedroom 3: Bunk Bed (Full over Full) Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Description Welcome to 'SeaWise' ! This 3 bed/3 bath townhome in Prominence is perfect for families and just steps from the 5,000 sq. ft. resort-style pool. New furniture & fixtures! Directly across the street from The Big Chill with restaurants, shops, & events! A complimentary 6-seater golf cart & bikes are included to enjoy scenic 30a! Gourmet kitchen & Smart TV's in every room. Beach access is only a short drive/bike ride away. No need to pack beach gear- we have you covered! **Pet Friendly (2 dog max up to 25lb. - $250/dog) TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: SeaWise comfortably accommodates up to 7 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 King Bedroom 3: (1) Bunk Bed (Twin over Queen) **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: OnHoliday30A comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 King Bedroom 3: (1) Bunk Bed (Full over Full) **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including porch *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Space must remain pet free! why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Hola Beaches', your dream escape on 30A professionally managed by Stay on 30A and designed for unforgettable coastal memories. This stunning 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom retreat was made for gathering, celebrating, and soaking up every second of paradise. Inside, the expansive open floor plan creates an effortless flow where laughter carries from the living room to the dining area and into the beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen. Whether you’re preparing fresh Gulf seafood, mixing sunset cocktails, or fueling up before a beach day, this kitchen is ready to impress and inspire. Step outside and the magic continues. There’s room to unwind, room to reconnect, and room to breathe in that salty coastal air. Morning coffee on the porch. Afternoon bike rides under blue skies. Evenings filled with golden-hour glow and the buzz of vacation energy. And the location? It doesn’t get better than this. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools, and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Seaside also has their own Framer's market! NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. Description Welcome to 'Maison de La Mer,' a stylish & centrally located 3 bed/3 bath townhome in Prominence, perfect for families. New furniture & fixtures! Directly across the street from The Big Chill with restaurants, shops, & events! We include a complimentary 4-seater golf cart & bikes to enjoy scenic 30a! Gourmet kitchen & Smart TV's in every room. Beach access is only a short drive/ bike ride away. No need to pack beach gear- we have you covered! If you prefer the pool, relax by the 5,000 sq. ft. community pool! TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Maison de La Mer comfortably accommodates up to 6 people: Bedroom 1: 1 Full Bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bedroom 3: 1 King, Ensuite **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the bikes. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 4 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles, baby trailer, and stroller for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. If you would like to rent a golf cart, the HOA requires it to be a 6-seater golf cart and it must be rented by their exclusive vendor, 30A Gulf Carts. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a Day Use Fee of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY THE HUB ) The community s town center, called The Big Chill, includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer s market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer s Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Pearly White' professionally managed by Stay on 30a, a show-stopping coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest, where luxury meets laid-back charm. Thoughtfully designed for relaxation, entertainment, and memory-making, this spacious home has everything you need for the ultimate 30A getaway. Dive into your own private screened-in pool complete with ample seating and a gas grill, perfect for poolside lounging or game-day viewing. Practice your short game on the private putting green or kick back in the first-floor game room packed with fun for all ages. Whip up delicious meals in the open kitchen, then gather on the large front porch or retreat to the second-floor covered balcony for sunset cocktails and breezy conversations. With private deeded beach access, six adult bikes, and a 6-seater golf cart, you're just minutes from the sand, scenic 30A trails, and everything Seacrest has to offer. Whether you’re here to play, relax, or explore Pearly White is your dream beach escape, wrapped in style and soaked in sunshine. Welcome to '513 on 30A' by Stay on 30a! Step into laid-back luxury at this brand-new home in the heart of Inlet Beach. With 4 beautifully appointed bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, this stylish retreat comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests and is designed for those who appreciate the finer touches of coastal living. This home features a sleek, modern aesthetic with clean lines, warm textures, and designer finishes throughout. The open-concept layout offers a seamless flow from the kitchen to the dining and living areas, making it the perfect setting for relaxed gatherings after a day at the beach.  Tucked in a quiet, upscale community, guests enjoy access to a community pool. The beach is a short, walk and your toes are in the sand. Included are 6 adult bikes, inviting you to explore 30A like a local, from the boutiques and cafes, to the charming coastal paths that wind through the area. Whether you're sitting on the patio, pedaling to sunset, or simply soaking up the peaceful surroundings, this home offers the perfect balance of modern style and beachside tranquility.  Please note there is a home being built next door, and construction may still be occurring.

Description Welcome to 'Sundrenched Sisters,'  a stylish & centrally located 3 bed/3 bath townhome in Prominence, perfect for families. New furniture & fixtures! Directly across the street from The Big Chill with restaurants, shops, & events! We include a complimentary 6-seater golf cart & bikes to enjoy scenic 30a! Gourmet kitchen & Smart TV's in every room. Beach access is only a short drive/ bike ride away. No need to pack beach gear- we have you covered! If you prefer the pool, relax by the 5,000 sq. ft. community pool! **Pet Friendly (2 Dogs- $250/dog) TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Sundrenched Sisters comfortably accommodates up to 9 people: Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bedroom 2: Bunk Room (1) Twin over Twin, (1) Twin over Full   Bedroom 3: 1 King, Ensuite **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach. When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience. Activities for every interest abound in Gulf Place. Unwind with a reflexology massage or enzyme facial at Awakening Wellness Organic Spa. Explore the palm tree-lined streets and neighborhood shops at Gulf Place Town Center. Ultimately, the best part of beach life is kicking off your shoes and feeling the sand between your toes. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 30A Unplugged , professionally managed by Stay on 30a! This one-of-a-kind lakeside retreat is intentionally designed with no Wi-Fi and no TVs, inviting you to slow down, unplug, and fully reset. Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street, the home boasts 65 feet of private Lake Powell frontage, overlooking the largest coastal dune lake in North America. Calm waters, abundant wildlife, and wide-open views create a peaceful backdrop you’ll feel the moment you arrive. Start your mornings on the screened-in porch with a hot cup of coffee and birdsong in the air, no screens, no rush, just you and the view. Adventure and relaxation live side by side here. Spend your days paddle boarding across glassy water, casting a line with the provided fishing poles, or unwinding in the home’s private sauna after a long day outdoors. Explore the nearby trails at Camp Helen State Park, bike along scenic 30A, or head to the beach just 0.7 miles away for a sun-soaked afternoon. Inside, the home is warm, inviting, and thoughtfully designed with an open-concept layout that brings everyone together. The kitchen, dining, and living spaces flow seamlessly perfect for cooking meals, sharing stories, playing games, and enjoying uninterrupted time with the people who matter most. Evenings are best spent outside under the stars, wrapped in good conversation and total calm. This isn’t just a stay it’s a true digital detox. No Wi-Fi. No TVs. Just intentional living, deeper connection, and the freedom to be present. When you’re ready to explore, you’re just minutes from the dining, shopping, and charm of 30Avenue, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach close enough for fun, far enough to keep the peace.

Description Welcome to 'Beach Bliss on 30A,'  a breathtaking retreat in the heart of Seagrove offering the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal charm. Just steps away from the pristine sands of Seagrove Beach, this is your ideal getaway destination for relaxation and adventure. This stunning 4 bed/4.5 bath home is located in a small gated community which offers privacy and a gorgeous multi-level pool for your enjoyment. We include 6 bikes and a golf cart to enjoy all that scenic 30A has to offer! ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 10 people: FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bedroom #2:  (2) Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR: Bedroom #3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower THIRD FLOOR: Bedroom #4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower BEACH ACCESS Three access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. Eastern Lake Beach Access is on the west side of Eastern Lake where the outfall meets the beach at the intersection of South Gulf Drive and Eastern Lake Road, about 1/4 mile south of Scenic 30A. The access has a shower, a bike rack, and a few parking spaces on Eastern Lake Drive. Eastern Lake is one of our rare coastal dune lakes in SoWal, which periodically open to exchange waters with the gulf. 2. Ramsgate Beach Access is a simple walkover near the end of Eastern Lake Road behind Summers Edge neighborhood beside Ramsgate townhomes. This access does not have parking or showers. 3. Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.6 miles East of the home) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. FEATURES 6-Seater Golf Cart  6 Bikes Multi-Level Community Pool with Fireplace & Sunset Tower Gated Community Steps from Beach 2 Covered Balconies Fully Stocked Kitchen Coffee Maker Outdoor Grill- Natural Gas Smart TVs Beach Gear **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING This home includes 2 parking space on the driveway with NO overflow parking available. No RV or trailer parking in the driveway. Violator's will be towed. ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. Seagrove is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm. You will find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party s needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.  *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *This home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie". Just a short walk to the seasonally heated resort-style pool, this beautifully designed getaway offers the perfect blend of relaxation and fun. Located just across the street from The Big Chill, you're steps away from great dining, live music, and entertainment. Hop on the bikes for an easy ride to the beach and scenic 30A hotspots. Whether you're lounging by the pool or exploring the coast, Sea Suite is the perfect place to make unforgettable beach memories! TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS Sea Suite comfortably accommodates up to 6 people: Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bedroom 2: 1 King Bedroom 3: King, Ensuite **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water FEATURES 6 Adult Bikes Short Walk to Resort-Style Pool Private Patio w/ Seating Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES 2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) Beautiful Cabana Area with Grills Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops Shopping Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More 30-A Bicycle Trail **Please Note: ** *Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. PARKING Two driveway spaces available. Garage parking is not allowed. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA recommends extra vehicles be parked at the pool. Included are 6 bicycles for your convenience. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools, and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. -Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including balcony. *No parties or events.  *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".
