Description Welcome to 'A Shore Bett,'  your ideal Seagrove Beach escape! This charming 3-bed, 3-bath home offers the prefect mix of comfort and coastal adventure. Enjoy multiple outdoor seating areas, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails, and take advantage of the private pool for ultimate relaxation. With a golf cart and 6 adult bikes included, exploring 30A's stunning beaches, shops, and restaurants is effortless! Whether you're unwinding in the sunshine or setting out for a day of adventure, A Shore Bett guarantees a vacation to remember. **Pet Friendly (2 Dogs- $250/dog) ACCOMMODATIONS A Shore Bett comfortably accommodates up to 10 people: Bedroom 1: (1) Twin/Full Bunk, (1) Twin/Twin Bunk, Shared Bath Bedroom 2: 1 King, Shared Bath Bedroom 3: 1 King,1 Full Sleeper Sofa, 1 Twin/Twin Bunk, Private Bath FEATURES 6-Seater Golf Cart 6 Adult Bikes Pet Friendly (2 Dogs Max, $250/dog fee) Private Pool - Heated upon request **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Fully Stocked Kitchen Full Washer & Dryer Large 2nd Floor Balcony Covered Outdoor Patio Smart TVs Beach Gear BEACH ACCESS Three access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. One Seagrove Place: One Seagrove Access is on Seagrove Place about 100 yards south of Scenic 30A across from Robert Ellis Street and has a shower and no parking. The access is across Scenic 30A from Cassine Gardens subdivision and next to One Seagrove Place Condominiums, one of only two high rises on Scenic 30A. 2. Santa Clara: Santa Clara beach access is located near Bramble Grove Road, about 3.5 miles to the west of Prominence. This beach has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. For your convenience beach chairs, umbrellas, and kayaks are available to rent from beach services. 3. Beachwood Villas: Beachwood Villas Access is on Scenic 30A across from Beachwood Villas, Somerset Bridge Road, and the Tom Thumb in Seagrove Beach, Florida. There is a bike rack but no car parking, and the access has a shower and quite a long boardwalk to the high bluff overlooking the gulf. **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING This home includes 2 parking space on the driveway with NO overflow parking available. No RV or trailer parking in the driveway. ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. Seagrove is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm. You will find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party s needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *Up to 2 dogs allowed. Pet fee of $250/dog applies. Host must be notified of pet prior to arrival. 2 Dogs Max! *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a . why_we_love_it_excerpt: Escape to 'Casa Al Mare 30A' , a newly built coastal retreat, nestled in the heart of Florida’s iconic 30A between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach! Offering an elevated luxury experience just an 8–10 minute walk to your private deeded beach access, Peddlers Pavilion, and an array of restaurants, boutiques, and entertainment. A complimentary tram stop across the street provides effortless access to the beach, Seacrest, and the lagoon-style community pool and café. Inside, the home is thoughtfully designed to reflect refined coastal luxury, featuring high-end furnishings, hardwood floors, curated art, and an open-concept layout ideal for gathering. The chef’s kitchen is fully equipped with multiple ovens, a wine cooler, and generous dining space for 12, plus additional seating for 4 at the island perfect for hosting group dinners, celebrations, and memorable girls’ getaways or bachelorette weekends. Step outside to a beautifully appointed back deck with seating for 6, ambient string lighting, and a built-in grill perfect for evening entertaining. The home boasts four spacious outdoor decks, including two private decks off king ensuite bedrooms, creating serene personal retreats. A second-floor deck features a beverage fridge and smart TV, ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach. Inside, each floor offers a comfortable living area with 85” smart TVs and Sonos surround sound. Description Welcome to '30A Beach Therapy,' a cozy 3 bed/ 2.5 bath retreat in the heart of Prominence! Just a short walk to the seasonally heated resort-style pool, this beautifully designed getaway offers the perfect blend of relaxation and fun. Located just across the street from The Big Chill, you're steps away from great dining, live music, and entertainment. Hop on the bikes for an easy ride to the beach and scenic 30A hotspots. Whether you're lounging by the pool or exploring the coast, 30a Beach Therapy is the perfect place to make unforgettable beach memories! TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: 30A Beach Therapy comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bedroom 2: 1 Full/Full Bunk Bedroom 3: 1 King, Ensuite  *WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water FEATURES 6 Adult Bikes Short Walk to Resort-Style Pool Private Patio w/ Seating Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear **Please note, this home does not include a golf cart. If you would like a golf cart during your stay, one can be rented *at a 10% discount* through 30A Gulf Carts, the exclusive golf cart provider for the community. The cart will be delivered directly to the property for your convenience. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES 2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) Beautiful Cabana Area with Grills Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops Shopping Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More 30-A Bicycle Trail **Please Note: ** *Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. PARKING Two driveway spaces available. Garage parking is not allowed. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA recommends extra vehicles be parked at the pool. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES 2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) Beautiful Cabana Area with Grills Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops Shopping Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More 30-A Bicycle Trail **Please Note: ** *Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. PARKING Two driveway spaces available. Garage parking is not allowed. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA recommends extra vehicles be parked at the pool. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. This show-stopping vacation home is designed for families and groups who crave style, comfort, and a touch of elegance, all just moments from 30A’s white-sand beaches, boutique shopping, and vibrant dining scene. Whether you're floating in the pool, biking to the beach, or simply enjoying slow mornings on the porch,  Hampton Palm 30A  offers an unforgettable backdrop for making memories. This is more than a vacation, it’s your elevated coastal escape.

Eastern Lake is one of our rare coastal dune lakes in SoWal, which periodically open to exchange waters with the gulf. 2. PARKING This home includes 4 parking spaces on the gravel driveway with NO overflow parking available. No RV or trailer parking in the driveway. NEIGHBORHOOD Many walkable neighborhood amenities including: -30-A Bicycle Trail -Greenway Station featuring shopping, coffee, ice cream, and dining ABOUT THE AREA Nestled along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A, Seagrove offers the perfect blend of old-Florida character and modern coastal comfort. With its sugar-white sand beaches, winding bike paths, and canopy of oaks and magnolias, this peaceful community is ideal for those seeking relaxation, outdoor adventure, and a true taste of 30A living. Enjoy easy access to beach walks, paddle boarding on nearby dune lakes, and some of the area’s best dining, all just minutes from your doorstep. The property is located within a short walk/bike to three access points to the beautiful Emerald Coast beaches - one of them to Eastern Lake, a coastal dune lake that flows right into the gulf- a phenomena that is found in one of 4 places in the World. You'll find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire party's needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 4 adult bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a Day Use Fee of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY THE HUB) The community s town center, called The Big Chill, includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer s market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer s Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Whether you’re enjoying quiet mornings on the patio, biking toward the sunset, or simply soaking in the calm of this coastal community,  Queen City by the Sea  offers a seamless blend of modern style, walkable convenience, and beachside tranquility.

why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Water and Wine'  professionally managed by Stay on 30A a coastal retreat designed for gathering, unwinding, and soaking in the best of 30A living. Perfectly situated within the private, gated community of WaterSound, this five-bedroom, 5.5-bath home sleeps up to 12 guests and offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. From the moment you arrive, the relaxed elegance of Water and Wine invites you to slow down and truly embrace vacation mode. Mornings are best spent sipping coffee on the outdoor patio while the neighborhood wakes around you. By midday, you can choose your own adventure cool off in your private pool, take a quick ride to one of the beautiful WaterSound community pools, or hop on the bikes for a breezy trip to the private beach access just minutes away.. Head up to the top level in the evening for a special treat of sweeping Gulf views that make sunset hour feel extra magical. Whether you’re enjoying a quiet drink, taking family photos, or simply letting the ocean breeze wash over you, it’s the perfect way to end the day. Exploring the area is effortless with eight adult bikes included with your stay. Ride over to The Big Chill, a lively gathering spot for dining, shopping, live music, and outdoor movies that’s perfect for guests of all ages. Beyond that, 30A’s scenic bike trails, charming beach towns, and world-class dining are all at your fingertips. Back at the house, evenings can be spent grilling and dining, swapping stories by the pool, or cozying up for a movie night. Every detail of Water and Wine is designed to make your stay feel easy, refreshing, and memorable whether you’re here for a week of family fun or a relaxing getaway with friends. With private beach access, a prime WaterSound location, and the perfect mix of private and community amenities, Water and Wine offers everything you need for a quintessential 30A vacation plus those Gulf views you’ll dream about long after you leave.

why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Paradiso Del Mare'  professionally managed by Stay on 30A a seven-bedroom Inlet Beach coastal haven where effortless elegance meets vacation indulgence. Sleeping up to 18 guests, this stunning retreat features a main home and a charming pool house, offering the perfect balance of togetherness and privacy for large families and groups. Enjoy a private pool, relaxing hot tub, and breathtaking Gulf views. All just a short walk from the sugar-white sands and minutes from the vibrant energy of Rosemary Beach. Inside, you’ll find open, sun-filled living spaces thoughtfully designed with refined coastal décor, high-end finishes, and a calming neutral palette. The fully stocked kitchen is a showpiece, featuring premium appliances, an oversized island, and every culinary tool needed for everything from casual breakfasts to celebratory dinners. The seamless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living areas makes gathering with loved ones effortless and memorable. The separate pool house provides its own stylish living space, perfect for guests who want a little extra privacy while still being close to the action. Start your mornings with coffee on the breezy balconies, where the sound of the waves and the salt-kissed air set the tone for the day. After beach adventures, boutique shopping in nearby Rosemary Beach, or an afternoon exploring the popular 30Avenue a lively destination for upscale dining, shopping, and entertainment. Unwind by the sparkling pool or soak in the hot tub as the sun dips below the horizon. Located in the heart of Inlet Beach, Paradiso Del Mare puts you steps from beach access, minutes from award-winning restaurants and shops, and close to the best of 30A’s coastal charm. For added ease, the home includes a golf cart and ten adult bikes, making it simple to explore the area or enjoy sunset rides along the coast. With Gulf views, upscale comforts, and the rare bonus of a private pool house, Paradiso Del Mare isn’t just a place to stay it’s where your most unforgettable vacation memories will be made.

why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Beach Please', a professionally managed Stay on 30A property offering refined coastal living in one of the most desirable locations along Scenic 30A. This thoughtfully appointed retreat features a bright, open-concept design with elevated finishes, generous living spaces, and a seamless flow ideal for both relaxed gatherings and extended stays. Natural light fills the interiors, highlighting the home’s clean coastal aesthetic and carefully curated furnishings. The screened-in porch offers a private setting for morning coffee or evening cocktails, while the outdoor fire pit creates an inviting space to unwind after a day at the beach. The kitchen is well-equipped for preparing everything from casual breakfasts to elegant dinners, opening effortlessly into the dining and living areas for easy entertaining. Comfortable bedrooms provide a restful escape, ensuring privacy and relaxation for families or groups traveling together. Beach days are effortless with included chairs, umbrellas, a wagon, and coolers, and the sparkling community pool is located just steps from the front door. The public beach access is less than a mile away, offering convenient proximity to the area’s iconic sugar-white sand and emerald waters. Your stay also includes four complimentary adult bikes, making it easy to explore 30A at your own pace whether cruising to the beach, heading to dinner, or enjoying a scenic ride to nearby communities. Ideally situated near 30Avenue’s upscale dining, boutique shopping, and seasonal events, the home is just a short bike ride to both Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, placing you within easy reach of two of 30A’s most distinguished coastal destinations. 'Beach Please' delivers comfort, style, and an exceptional location, creating a polished and elevated 30A experience designed for those who expect more from their coastal getaway.

Description Welcome to 'Coastal Hip-Nautic,'  your dreamy coastal escape tucked in the vibrant Prominence community on 30A! Perfectly positioned just across the street from The Big Chill, you'll be steps from live music, great food, boutique shopping, and fun for the whole family. This stylish and spacious 3 bed/2.5 bath beach retreat offers the best of both relaxation and adventure. Spend your days soaking up the sun at one of Prominence’s two resort-style pools, or cruise to one of four nearby beach accesses in the included 6-seater golf cart or on one of the six adult bikes. Inside, you’ll find a bright, open-concept layout with coastal chic décor, perfect for gathering after a day on the sand. Whether you're exploring 30A, unwinding poolside, or heading out for a night at The Big Chill, Coastal Hip-Nautic is the perfect home base for unforgettable beachside memories. **Pet Friendly (2 Dogs- $250/dog) TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Coastal Hip-Nautic comfortably accommodates up to 10 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 King Bedroom 3: (2) Bunk Beds (XL Twin over Twin) Living Room: Sleeper Sofa **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water FEATURES 6 Adult Bikes 3 Children Bikes 6 Seater Golf Cart Resort-Style Community Pool Large Private Patio Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear Pet friendly- Pet $250/dog applies.  WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies More -30-A Bicycle Trail **Please Note: ** *Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Secure Booking Experience Description Welcome to 'Coastal Hip-Nautic,'  your dreamy coastal escape tucked in the vibrant Prominence community on 30A! Perfectly positioned just across the street from The Big Chill, you'll be steps from live music, great food, boutique shopping, and fun for the whole family. This stylish and spacious 3 bed/2.5 bath beach retreat offers the best of both relaxation and adventure. Spend your days soaking up the sun at one of Prominence’s two resort-style pools, or cruise to one of four nearby beach accesses in the included 6-seater golf cart or on one of the six adult bikes. Inside, you’ll find a bright, open-concept layout with coastal chic décor, perfect for gathering after a day on the sand. Whether you're exploring 30A, unwinding poolside, or heading out for a night at The Big Chill, Coastal Hip-Nautic is the perfect home base for unforgettable beachside memories. **Pet Friendly (2 Dogs- $250/dog) TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Coastal Hip-Nautic comfortably accommodates up to 10 people: Bedroom 1: 1 King, Ensuite  Bedroom 2: 1 King Bedroom 3: (2) Bunk Beds (XL Twin over Twin) Living Room: Sleeper Sofa **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water FEATURES 6 Adult Bikes 3 Children Bikes 6 Seater Golf Cart Resort-Style Community Pool Large Private Patio Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear Pet friendly- Pet $250/dog applies.  WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies More -30-A Bicycle Trail **Please Note: ** *Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to ' 30A Dunes ' professionally managed by Stay on 30a. A 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in the gated community of WaterSound that comfortably sleeps 8. This inviting retreat blends timeless coastal charm with elevated design and craftsmanship, creating a warm and elegant escape just steps from the Gulf! Inside, the home’s thoughtful design shines through in every detail, from the Venetian plaster walls to the 100-year-old repurposed wooden beams that add both texture and character. The open-concept living and dining spaces offer the perfect backdrop for gathering with family and friends, while the well-equipped kitchen makes preparing meals and entertaining a pleasure. Step outside to your own private oasis featuring a sparkling pool and a spacious screened-in porch complete with a fireplace and TV, perfect for slow mornings with coffee or cozy evenings under the glow of the fire. When you’re ready for sand and surf, the private deeded beach access is just steps away, offering effortless days along the sugar-white shoreline. Guests also enjoy access to two community pools and six adult bikes, ideal for exploring the scenic paths, trails, and neighboring coastal towns along 30A. With its refined interiors, inviting outdoor spaces, and unbeatable location, 30A Dunes offers the perfect balance of comfort, craftsmanship, and coastal relaxation.

TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room W/Sleeper Sofa, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Sunshine for the Soul comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: Bedroom 1: Queen  Bedroom 2: King Bedroom 3: King, With Ensuite Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa  FEATURES: 6 Adult Bikes 6 Seater Golf Cart Large Private Patio Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear Walking Distance to The Big Chill **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and driver's license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including porch *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Space must remain pet free! *There are no refunds for weather related events. We advise trip insurance during hurricane season (May-November) IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Sea Eagle' professionally managed by Stay on 30a, a beautifully styled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome in the heart of Prominence, designed with families and small groups in mind. From the moment you step inside, you’ll feel right at home with fresh, modern furnishings, an open-concept layout, and thoughtful details that make this space as functional as it is comfortable. The living area flows seamlessly into the gourmet kitchen, complete with high-end appliances and all the essentials needed for everything from a quick breakfast before the beach to a family dinner at home. Each bedroom is outfitted with plush bedding and Smart TVs, ensuring everyone has a cozy retreat of their own after a full day of fun. The location of Sea Eagle is truly hard to beat. Just across the street, you’ll find The Big Chill, a lively gathering spot with restaurants, boutique shopping, family-friendly events, and live music. For a more serene experience, head a short ride away to Deer Lake State Park, where you can walk the boardwalk across untouched dunes and enjoy one of the most pristine stretches of sand along 30A. With a complimentary 6-seater golf cart and 6 adult bikes included with your stay, you’ll have endless opportunities to explore the surrounding communities, trails, and beaches without the hassle of driving. This home is located within Prominence, home to a spectacular 5,000 sq. ft. resort-style pool with cabanas, lounge seating, and plenty of room to soak up the Florida sunshine. For beach days, we’ve got you covered with all the essentials so you can pack light and focus on making memories. Whether you’re planning to spend your mornings biking along scenic 30A, your afternoons exploring nearby state parks, or your evenings enjoying dinner and live music at The Big Chill, Sea Eagle offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. It’s a place where your vacation feels effortless and every detail is designed to help you make the most of your time at the beach. **Sea Eagle will donate a wreath to Wreaths Across America for every stay through the remainder of 2025. **

Whether you’re planning to spend your mornings biking along scenic 30A, your afternoons exploring nearby state parks, or your evenings enjoying dinner and live music at The Big Chill, Sea Eagle offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. It’s a place where your vacation feels effortless and every detail is designed to help you make the most of your time at the beach. TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Sea Eagle comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: Bedroom 1: King, Ensuite. Bedroom 2: Queen. Bedroom 3: Twin/Full Bunk W/ Trundle Bed. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water FEATURES 6 Adult Bikes 6 Seater Golf Cart Resort-Style Community Pool Large Private Patio Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including porch *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Salty Sandbar' professionally managed by Stay on 30a, a stylish 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome, perfectly situated in the heart of Prominence. Thoughtfully designed for families and small groups, this home blends comfort with coastal sophistication. Step inside to find a bright, open-concept layout featuring modern furnishings, cozy touches, and spaces that feel both functional and inviting. The living area flows into a fully stocked kitchen with high-end appliances and everything you need whether it’s whipping up a quick breakfast before the beach or gathering for a family-style dinner. Each bedroom is a private retreat of its own, complete with smart tvs to wind down after a day in the sun. Outside the front door, you’ll discover one of the best locations on 30A. Just across the street, The Big Chill offers dining, boutique shopping, live music, and family-friendly entertainment.  Take a short ride to Deer Lake State Park and stroll the boardwalk over untouched dunes leading to one of the most pristine beaches on the coast. To make exploring a breeze, your stay includes a 6-seater golf cart and six adult bikes perfect for cruising to nearby communities, trails, and beaches. Within Prominence, you’ll also have access to the 5,000 sq. ft. resort-style pool, complete with cabanas, plenty of lounge space, and endless Florida sunshine. For beach days, we provide all the essentials so you can travel light and focus on the fun. Whether it’s biking along scenic 30A in the morning, discovering hidden gems at local state parks in the afternoon, or capping off the day with dinner and live music at The Big Chill, Salty Sandbar makes every moment effortless. Here, comfort, convenience, and coastal charm come together for a vacation you’ll never forget.

WaterColor Beach Club: Access is through WaterColor Beach Club & just a 5 minute walk to beautiful white sand beaches. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.  NEARBY  PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS -Ray's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar. -Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two parking spaces available (2 driveway). No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only. 4 adult bikes for your convenience. GUEST ACCESS The WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. This bright and airy 3-bedroom condo in Seagrove Beach is all about easy living on 30A. Just steps to the sand, room for everyone, and those little touches that make a trip unforgettable. Think open spaces, coastal-chic décor, and a full kitchen stocked for family breakfasts or sunset snacks. With three comfy bedrooms and two full baths, there’s plenty of space for your crew to spread out, unwind, and feel at home. Mornings start best with coffee on your private balcony overlooking the pool and courtyard. When you’re ready to explore, hop on the two adult bikes included with your stay and cruise the 30A bike path to local cafés and coastal boutiques. Whether it’s a family getaway, a friends’ weekend, or a long, lazy beach break, this condo puts you right in the heart of 30A’s laid-back charm.  Perfectly located, stylishly designed, and only steps from the sand. This Seagrove Beach condo is ready to be your home away from home on 30A. **No elevator, stairs are required.** *As part of ongoing community improvements, the Beachwood Villas HOA will be performing exterior enhancements from January–April 2026.*

This bright and airy 3-bedroom condo in Seagrove Beach is all about easy living on 30A. Just steps to the sand, room for everyone, and those little touches that make a trip unforgettable. Think open spaces, coastal-chic décor, and a full kitchen stocked for family breakfasts or sunset snacks. With three comfy bedrooms and two full baths, there’s plenty of space for your crew to spread out, unwind, and feel at home. Mornings start best with coffee on your private balcony overlooking the pool and courtyard. Grab your flip-flops, the dedicated beach access is directly across the street and spend the day on the sugar-white sand. When you’re ready to explore, hop on the two adult bikes included with your stay and cruise the 30A bike path to local cafés and coastal boutiques. Whether it’s a family getaway, a friends’ weekend, or a long, lazy beach break, this condo puts you right in the heart of 30A’s laid-back charm.  Perfectly located, stylishly designed, and only steps from the sand. This Seagrove Beach condo is ready to be your home away from home on 30A. **No elevator, stairs are required.** *As part of ongoing community improvements, the Beachwood Villas HOA will be performing exterior enhancements from January–April 2026.* CONDO FEATURES -Community pool heated seasonally (March & April) -Tennis/Pickleball courts -Shuffleboard -Gas grills by pool area -Short walk to beach access -2 Adult bikes -Smart tv  -Fully stocked kitchen  -Keurig/drip coffee makers -Beach gear -Short distance to access restaurants, market, shops, and entertainment -Complimentary wifi -Full washer and dryer -Unit on second floor ACCOMMODATIONS: Saltwater Therapy accommodates up to 8 people: Bed 1: King, with ensuite bathroom Bed 2: Bunk room, featuring (2) Twin/Twin Bed 3: Queen **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Parking access available in front of building. We provide 2 bikes for your convenience! NEARBY BEACH ACCESS 1. Pelayo Beach Access (100 ft from the home) is on Scenic 30A at the intersection of Pelayo Avenue across from Hidden Beach Villas. There is a shower and a bike rack but no car parking. A long boardwalk through a grove of coastal trees leads to a large deck with seating on high bluff overlooking the gulf. 2. Santa Clara beach (0.2 Miles from the home) access is located near Bramble Grove Road. This beach has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. For your convenience beach chairs, umbrellas, and kayaks are available to rent from beach services. 3. Campbell St. Beach Access (800 ft. from the home) is on Scenic 30A across from Campbell Street and the Seagrove Plaza. **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. Seagrove is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm. You will find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire parties needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited. *No parties or events.  *Complimentary bikes (2) provided. Waiver must be completed for bike lock code. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no wifi, or slow wifi. *This unit must remain pet free. *There are no refunds for weather related events. We advise trip insurance during hurricane season (May-November) IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Barefoot Bungalow,' a charming WaterColor retreat professionally curated and managed by Stay on 30A. This beautifully updated three-bedroom, two-bath cottage captures the essence of effortless coastal living, blending refined comfort with the laid-back elegance that defines life along 30A. Inside, a bright and welcoming open layout invites connection and ease. Whether you’re enjoying morning coffee at the breakfast bar, gathering for a home-cooked meal, or unwinding in the cozy living room after a sun-soaked day, every space is designed to feel relaxed yet thoughtfully elevated. Soft coastal finishes, warm natural light, and inviting furnishings create an atmosphere that instantly signals vacation mode. Step out onto the private porch to soak in the gentle 30A breeze, perfect for slow mornings with a book or peaceful evenings under pastel sunset skies. Each bedroom offers a comfortable, serene retreat, ensuring every guest can rest and recharge. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to 'Tuck’s Place,' a thoughtfully curated Seacrest Beach retreat professionally managed by Stay on 30A. Perfectly situated in one of 30A’s most sought-after communities, this beautifully designed home offers a seamless blend of elevated style, relaxed comfort, and the effortless charm that defines coastal living along Scenic 30A. Designed with families and groups in mind,  Tuck’s Place  provides generous living spaces, intentional design details, and an atmosphere that feels both refined and welcoming. Inside, soft coastal tones, natural textures, and carefully selected décor create a calm, inviting environment that immediately sets the tone for an unhurried vacation. The home flows easily from one space to the next, making it ideal for gathering, sharing meals, and enjoying time together while still offering room to unwind. The location is just as special as the home itself. Guests enjoy private, deeded beach access with complimentary tram service, making trips to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf simple and stress-free. The charming Seacrest town center and one of 30A’s most iconic lagoon-style resort pools are just a short walk away, placing dining, shopping, and relaxation all within easy reach. Days at  Tuck’s Place  unfold effortlessly. Start your mornings riding the included adult bikes to neighboring Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, spend afternoons soaking up the sun along the shoreline, and return home in the evenings to relax on the porch as warm Gulf breezes drift through. From beautifully furnished interiors to peaceful outdoor spaces designed for slow mornings and sunset conversations, every detail invites you to slow down and savor the moment. At  Tuck’s Place , luxury feels natural, comfort comes easily, and every stay is an opportunity to reconnect, unwind, and create lasting memories along 30A.

It is the ultimate amenity with three pools, expanded seating on upper and lower decks, and lounge areas. The Beach Club has several food and beverage options onsite, towel service, and a charming mercantile with sundries for your pool day. With unobstructed and panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, relaxation and pleasure await you at the Beach Club. Visit the WaterColor Beach Club page for facility hours, lounge chair etiquette, restaurant information, and rules. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.  NEARBY  PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS -Ray's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar. -Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available (3 driveway). No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community. The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an adults only pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf! Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for younger kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground. OTHER THINGS TO NOTE Beach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance. Per Watercolor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands max.  In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking, which you will receive a prompted email prior to your arrival. The HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here. The WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration a minimum of 1 week prior to arrival. Regarding the WaterColor pools, until water temperatures are consistently warm enough on their own, WaterColor's pools are maintained around 82 degrees. Just a short stroll away, you’ll find the resort-style, zero-entry pool that Magnolia Cottages is known for. To elevate your stay even more, take advantage of the included 6-seater golf cart and four adult bikes, giving you fun and flexible ways to explore 30A. Cruise to Rosemary, browse the boutiques of Alys, or bike over to The Big Chill for dinner and live music. This home is a true gem within Magnolia Cottages, combining inviting interiors, convenient amenities, and the charm of a perfectly located beach community. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to Best Kept Seacrest, a beautifully appointed coastal retreat professionally designed for effortless 30A living. Perfectly positioned just a short walk to Scenic 30A, this beautifully designed coastal home offers the ultimate blend of walkability, comfort, and elevated vacation living. Nestled between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, places world-class dining, boutique shopping, and iconic 30A charm.  Inside, the home features three king en-suite bedrooms, each offering a private retreat, along with a spacious bunk room with its own dedicated bathroom. An ideal setup for families and groups seeking both connection and personal space. An additional half bath adds convenience for entertaining and everyday living. The main living areas are designed for gathering and unwinding after full days at the beach. Step outside to enjoy multiple outdoor living spaces, perfect for morning coffee, relaxed afternoons, or grilling and dining together after sunset. These inviting outdoor areas extend the living space and create easy moments to slow down and enjoy the coastal atmosphere. Outdoor access and exploration are effortless. With on-site parking for three vehicles and four complimentary adult bikes, cruising along 30A’s scenic bike paths and exploring nearby coastal communities is simple and enjoyable. A nearby tram stop provides stress-free beach access through the Villas at Sunset Beach, making beach days seamless from start to finish. As a guest, you’ll enjoy private deeded beach access and access to a resort-style community pool just moments away offering the perfect balance between Gulf-front adventures and laid-back poolside afternoons. Whether you’re spending the day at the beach, biking to dinner in Rosemary Beach, or exploring the striking beauty of Alys Beach, Best Kept Seacrest delivers a refined 30A experience that feels easy, elevated, and unforgettable.

Perfectly positioned for both relaxation and adventure,  SSYS by the Sea  is a thoughtfully curated escape designed for guests who appreciate refined comfort and unforgettable moments. Whether your days are spent poolside or discovering the beauty of 30A, this home offers a luxury coastal experience you’ll want to return to year after year. **The home does not include a golf cart until March 1st.**

Close to Grayton State Park & Access to the Coastal Dune Lakes (Great for Kayaking & Yolo Boarding) Close Access to Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining Easy Access to Parks & Walking Paths Nearby State Parks & Preserves Parking for 3 Vehicles ACCOMMODATIONS: FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1: King with Ensuite SECOND FLOOR: Bedroom #2: King with Ensuite Bedroom #3: (2) Full/Full Bunks Ensuite Bedroom #4: King with Ensuite  PRIVATE BEACH & RESORT ACCESS -The WaterColor Beach Club is the only beachfront clubhouse pool available to rental guests along 30A. It is the ultimate amenity with three pools, expanded seating on upper and lower decks, and lounge areas. The Beach Club has several food and beverage options onsite, towel service, and a charming mercantile with sundries for your pool day. With unobstructed and panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, relaxation and pleasure await you at the Beach Club. Visit the WaterColor Beach Club page for facility hours, lounge chair etiquette, restaurant information, and rules. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.  NEARBY  PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS -Ray's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar. -Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available (3 driveway). No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only. 4 adult bikes for your convenience. GUEST ACCESS The WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community. The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an adults only pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf! Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for younger kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground. OTHER THINGS TO NOTE Beach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance. Per Watercolor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands max.  In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking, which you will receive a prompted email prior to your arrival. The HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here. The WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration a minimum of 1 week prior to arrival. Regarding the WaterColor pools, until water temperatures are consistently warm enough on their own, WaterColor's pools are maintained around 82 degrees. A $500 deposit is held at the time of golf cart rental and will be refunded at checkout, pending inspection for any damage. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *This home is allotted 10 wristbands max per HOA. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events. *No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. *This home must remain pet free.
