why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to "Palm Paradise," an elevated Seacrest Beach retreat professionally curated and managed by Stay on 30A. Perfectly positioned right on Scenic 30A and just steps from the Village Town Center, this beautifully designed coastal home offers the ultimate blend of walkability, comfort, and elevated vacation living. Nestled between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach,  Palm Paradise  places world-class dining, boutique shopping, and iconic 30A charm right outside your door while still offering the peaceful feeling of a private getaway. Inside, you’ll find designer finishes and thoughtful details throughout, creating a space that feels both sophisticated and effortlessly welcoming. The home features four bedrooms, including two king primary suites, offering the ideal layout for families and groups seeking a balance of connection and privacy. The chef-inspired kitchen with quartz countertops and custom finishes flows seamlessly into the main living space, anchored by a cozy gas fireplace, perfect for relaxed evenings after beach days or sunset rides along 30A. One of the standout features of  Palm Paradise  is the game room with bunks and its own kitchenette, providing an additional space to spread out, entertain, or create the perfect “kids’ retreat” while the rest of the group unwinds upstairs. Step outside to enjoy multiple private balconies, each offering ample seating and inviting places to gather. For the best views, head to the third-floor balcony featuring stunning Gulf views, an unforgettable backdrop for morning coffee, golden-hour conversations, and quiet coastal moments. Outdoor living is just as thoughtfully designed. Fire up the grill, then enjoy dinner together on the patio dining space, ideal for al fresco meals and easy evenings under the stars. As a guest, you’ll enjoy inclusive access to Seacrest’s community pools and private beach access, making beach days effortless and poolside afternoons just as inviting. With six complimentary bikes included, exploring 30A’s scenic paths and neighboring coastal communities is as easy as stepping outside. Whether you’re spending the day at the beach, walking to coffee and dinner in the Village Town Center, or cruising to Rosemary and Alys Beach,  Palm Paradise  offers a luxury 30A experience that feels easy, elevated, and unforgettable.

why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to Sea Mist, professionally managed by Stay on 30a where laid-back luxury meets the best of 30A living! This beautiful four-bedroom home comfortably sleeps up to ten guests and is perfectly located in the heart of Prominence, one of 30A’s most sought-after communities. From the moment you arrive, Sea Mist invites you to slow down, spread out, and settle into vacation mode. Inside, the home offers spacious, light-filled living areas designed for gathering, relaxing, and making memories together. Whether you’re sharing meals, planning your next beach day, or winding down after sunset, there’s room for everyone to feel right at home. One of the bedrooms features a bunk room, making this space especially ideal for families, kids, and group trips. Step outside onto the front porch and let the sound of the Gulf set the tone for your stay. When you’re ready to explore, you’re just steps away from the community pool and only a short walk to The Big Chill, where you’ll find restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and frequent events that bring Prominence to life day and night. Beach days are effortless here. Enjoy a quick golf cart ride to nearby beach access and spend your time soaking up the sun, swimming in emerald waters, or strolling along the iconic sugar-white sand. Want to explore more of 30A? Cruise over to Seaside by golf cart or bike and experience some of the area’s best dining, boutiques, and coastal charm. To make your stay even better, Sea Mist includes a six-seat golf cart and bikes, giving you everything you need to enjoy the scenic beauty and relaxed pace of 30A. Whether you’re here for a family getaway, a friends’ retreat, or a longer coastal escape, Sea Mist delivers comfort, convenience, and that unforgettable beach-town vibe. This isn’t just a place to stay, it’s your home base for experiencing 30A at its best.

PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools, and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside also has their own Framer's market! NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to Off Piste Cottage, a stunning coastal retreat professionally curated and managed by Stay on 30A. Perfectly located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach and less than 600 yards from door to the public beach access. This thoughtfully designed four-bedroom home was created with both comfort and connection in mind, making it ideal for family vacations, group getaways, or friends traveling together. From the moment you step inside, the home welcomes you with effortless coastal sophistication. The layout flows naturally from one gathering space to the next, perfect for slow mornings with coffee, relaxed afternoons between beach trips, and easy evenings spent reconnecting after a day along 30A. The fully stocked kitchen is designed to make group stays effortless. Whether you're preparing a quick breakfast before the beach or cooking a full dinner for the group, you’ll find everything you need to feel right at home. It’s a space built not just for cooking, but for gathering where conversations continue long after the plates are cleared. Each bedroom offers its own calm and comfortable space, giving everyone room to unwind, and the home features private balconies perfect for stepping outside with a morning coffee, catching a coastal breeze, or enjoying quiet moments before the day begins. Just across the street, you’ll find the community pool, making it incredibly easy to cool off, lounge in the sun, or take a refreshing dip whenever the mood strikes. Exploring the area is just as effortless. Your stay includes six adult bikes, making it easy to cruise through Blue Mountain Beach, reach nearby beach access points, and explore neighboring 30A communities at your own pace. And if your group is looking for a little extra flexibility, there’s a golf cart rental shop just down the street, making it simple to add a cart during your stay. Known for its laid-back atmosphere, scenic beauty, and proximity to local favorites, Blue Mountain Beach offers a more relaxed side of 30A perfect for guests who want to slow down without sacrificing access to the best dining, beaches, and coastal experiences the area has to offer. At Off Piste Cottage, thoughtful design, modern comfort, and coastal charm come together to create the perfect setting for meaningful moments, shared experiences, and unforgettable memories along 30A.

Turn by Goatfeathers Seafood restaurant at Gulfview Heights street. 2. Shellseekers Beach Access is a simple walkover at the end of Shellseekers Cove about one block south of Scenic 30A and a few blocks east of the Scenic 393 intersection at Gulf Place. The area is dotted with beloved local spots, from homemade ice cream at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery to casual bites at Red Fish Taco and slow-smoked favorites from Blue Mabel Smokehouse. Locally owned shops, bike paths, and friendly gathering places add to the community feel, making Blue Mountain the perfect escape for those seeking an authentic, unhurried 30A experience. -Just a short bike ride away is Gulf Place. A beach neighborhood where inspiration waits around every corner. Whether you’re a beach bum, foodie, shopper, or art lover, you’ll find your passion here. From live music venues to innovative art spaces, there’s a whole world to explore. Start your morning off right with a latte and sweet treat from Sunrise Coffee Co. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach. When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience. Exploring the area is just as effortless. Your stay includes six adult bikes, making it easy to cruise through Blue Mountain Beach, reach nearby beach access points, and explore neighboring 30A communities at your own pace. And if your group is looking for a little extra flexibility, there’s a golf cart rental shop just down the street, making it simple to add a cart during your stay. Known for its laid-back atmosphere, scenic beauty, and proximity to local favorites, Blue Mountain Beach offers a more relaxed side of 30A perfect for guests who want to slow down without sacrificing access to the best dining, beaches, and coastal experiences the area has to offer. At Off Piste Cottage, thoughtful design, modern comfort, and coastal charm come together to create the perfect setting for meaningful moments, shared experiences, and unforgettable memories along 30A. It has parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with shelter, and lifeguards during peak season. Located less than 600 yards from the home. Turn by Goatfeathers Seafood restaurant at Gulfview Heights street. 2. Shellseekers Beach Access is a simple walkover at the end of Shellseekers Cove about one block south of Scenic 30A and a few blocks east of the Scenic 393 intersection at Gulf Place. It may be the most well hidden access in SoWal. 3. Spooky Lane Beach Access is at the entrance to Seahaunts Condominiums where Spooky Lane meets the Gulf. As the highest elevation along Scenic Highway 30A, it offers scenic dune views, peaceful beaches, and some of the most stunning sunsets on the Gulf. The area is dotted with beloved local spots, from homemade ice cream at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery to casual bites at Red Fish Taco and slow-smoked favorites from Blue Mabel Smokehouse. Locally owned shops, bike paths, and friendly gathering places add to the community feel, making Blue Mountain the perfect escape for those seeking an authentic, unhurried 30A experience. -Just a short bike ride away is Gulf Place. From live music venues to innovative art spaces, there’s a whole world to explore. Start your morning off right with a latte and sweet treat from Sunrise Coffee Co. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach. When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience. why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to Resting Beach Place, professionally managed by Stay on 30A, your relaxed and well-located coastal retreat just off Scenic Highway 30A. Perfectly positioned for easy beach days and effortless exploring, this inviting vacation home offers comfort, convenience, and laid-back coastal charm for your next 30A getaway. Step inside and feel instantly at ease. Designed with families and groups in mind, Resting Beach Place blends coastal style with practical, welcoming spaces that make it easy to settle in and enjoy time together. The open-concept living area features comfortable seating, coastal-inspired finishes, and natural light that creates a bright, airy space to unwind after a day in the sun. The layout flows seamlessly into the home’s private porches, extending your living space outdoors and offering peaceful spots to relax and recharge. The fully equipped kitchen is thoughtfully designed for both convenience and connection, with quality appliances, ample prep space, and everything you need to prepare meals or snacks between beach adventures.  Kids will love the bunk beds, a favorite gathering spot for movie nights, sleepovers, and making unforgettable vacation memories, while adults enjoy knowing there’s space for everyone to spread out and unwind. Upstairs, the second-floor porch offers charming golf views, the perfect backdrop for morning coffee or evening wind-downs after a full day on 30A. To elevate your stay even more, take advantage of the included four adult bikes, giving you fun and flexible ways to explore 30A. Cruise to Rosemary, browse the boutiques of Alys, or bike over to The Big Chill for dinner and live music. Just steps away, guests can enjoy the community pool, ideal for cooling off after the beach or spending an easy afternoon close to home. With the beach, dining, shopping, and local favorites all nearby, everything you need is within reach. With its prime location off 30A, family-friendly layout, private porches, and community amenities, Resting Beach Place is the perfect setting to slow down, soak in the coastal lifestyle, and create beach memories that last long after your stay ends.
